question: Ricky Kej a globally acclaimed musician from India won the 57th Grammy Award for which of the following contributions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Winds of Samsara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is also the concept of rebirth and "cyclicality of all life, matter, existence", a fundamental belief of most **Indian religions.**
 
• **Samsara** is sometimes referred to with terms or phrases such as transmigration, karmic cycle, **reincarnation** or **punarjanman,** and "cycle of aimless drifting, wandering or mundane existence"
 
• The liberation from **Samsara** is called **moksha**, **nirvana**, Mukti or **kaivalya.**

• **Grammy Awards **

 
 
• The renowned Grammy Awards, initially named the** Gramophone Award,** are presented annually in the United States by the **National Academy of Recording Arts & Sciences (NARAS)** to recognize outstanding achievements in the music industry.
 
• Established in **1959 **to honor performers from the year 1958, the committee chose the name "Grammy" as a homage to Emile Berliner's gramophone, underscoring its connection to the history of music recording.
 
• The Grammy Awards celebrate artists for their exceptional contributions to the music field, symbolizing a prestigious acknowledgment by the Recording Academy for outstanding work in a given year.
